mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: flAIghts was born as a Final Degree Project with the goal of revolutionizing flight searching using artificial intelligence. We want planning your next trip to be as simple as having a conversation.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To become the leading intelligent travel assistant, removing technical barriers and facilitating access to the best flight options through the power of AI.

values.title: Our Values
values.content: Innovation, transparency, and accessibility. We believe in technology as a bridge to connect people and destinations intelligently.

team.title: The Team
team.content: We are a team passionate about technology and travel, focused on creating tools that provide real value to users.

acknowledgements.content: We would like to express our most sincere gratitude to <1>SerpApi</1> for their generosity in providing us with the necessary credits free of charge for this academic project. Their support has been fundamental to the development of this Final Degree Project, allowing us to integrate real-time flight searches that would otherwise not have been possible due to infrastructure costs. Thank you for supporting university talent.

consent.checkbox_label: I consent to the processing of my interaction data linked to my user for the Final Degree Project.
consent.details_description: The evaluation consists of performing a series of missions that go through all the functionalities of the platform. Each mission has its own instructions and steps to perform.
consent.feedback_process:
At the end of each mission, you will have to rate how easy it was for you, and give feedback or a general opinion on the functionality you have tried.
Once all missions are finished, you will have to complete a final questionnaire to finish the evaluation.
consent.important_notice_description: You must perform the evaluation on this same device, as progress is local and is not synchronized with your account between different browsers or computers.
consent.invitation: Therefore, we invite you to perform the interactive evaluation of our website. It will only take a few minutes, and you will receive a badge for your collaboration!
consent.privacy_notice: To link results with your activity, we will collect data associated with your session. We will only use this information for academic purposes and usability analysis.
consent.tfg_notice: We are currently developing this application as a Final Degree Project (TFG) and we need your collaboration to evaluate the user experience.
consent.tutorial_description: Upon acceptance, an interactive guide will begin. We recommend following it to not miss any details of the mission system.
consent.welcome: Welcome to flAIghts, an application that helps you find flights, it's your travel agent and much more!

howWeUse.content: We may use the information we collect from and about you to:

items.item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services;
items.item2: Process transactions and send related information, including confirmations and invoices;
items.item3: Send you technical notices, updates, security alerts, and support and administrative messages;
items.item4: Respond to your comments, questions, and requests, and provide customer service;
items.item5: Communicate with you about products, services, offers, promotions, and events.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Information

information.content: We collect information you provide directly to us. For example, we collect information when you create an account, participate in any interactive features of our services, fill out a form, request customer support, or otherwise communicate with us. The types of information we may collect include your name, email address, postal address, password, flight preferences, search history, and other contact or identifying information you choose to provide.

security.content: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and destruction. However, no security system is impenetrable and we cannot guarantee the security of our systems 100%. In the event that any information under our control is compromised as a result of a breach of security, we will take reasonable steps to investigate the situation and, where appropriate, notify those individuals whose information may have been compromised and take other steps, in accordance with any applicable laws and regulations.
security.title: 3. Data Security

preferences.title: Search Weights
preferences.weightsInfo: Take into account that if you give much more importance to one of the fields, you should represent it correctly in relation to the others. That is, if you care that the flight is short, but you care much more that the price is cheap, don't set the duration to 1, leave it at a lower value so the algorithm prioritizes the price.
